confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates are least certain and vary by district and season. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draft pour. Cocktail and wine_glass were cross-checked against beer (about 2.7x and 1.5x) since direct knowledge is weaker. FX 0.7002 (RBA 4pm, 14 Oct 2026) came from search-result summaries attributing it to rba.gov.au pages, not a direct read of the RBA table, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-cost Central and Southeast European capitals such as Sofia and Budapest, adjusted to Romanian local price levels. No single comparable city was priced directly.
